text:
Priya: quick intake on Perseus-30B — customer X flagged latency for chat flows. asking: do we push this up the priority list for a 4-bit quant + kernel tune run this week? :thinking_face:
Sam: link to the intake scoring sheet? want to see perf vs cost tradeoffs before moving it up.
Priya: https://go/research/perseus-intake (brief summary in sheet). TL;DR: strong quality, currently 180ms median token on hosted, target <120ms. customer timeline: end of month.
Leo: curious about instruction-following regressions — last time a 4-bit path for a 30B-ish model shifted few-shot behavior on our LLM-eval suites. we should add parity checks on the convo and summarization tasks.
Anya: agree. propose experiment plan: (1) 4-bit static quant baseline, (2) 4-bit + act-order kernel, (3) 8-bit fallback for long contexts. run suite: ff_world, convo-robust, summarization-10k.
Ben: owners + ETA? I can take the infra side for dedicated runs if we get the model artifacts. ETA: start Wed, 48h job for the main sweep.
Priya: owners: Ben (infra), Leo (quality/evals), Sam (cost calc & bench). I'll own rollout gating and customer comms. checklist for the experiment: 
- get model weights + permissive license
- spawn dedicated job pool (Ben)
- run quant sweep (Sam + Ben)
- run eval battery and regression alerts (Leo + eval-bot)
- perf kernel profiling (eng-runtime)
- decide canary policy (Priya)

Sam: quick note on cost calc: if 4-bit hits perf target we can save ~35-40% token CPU cost vs fp16. need batch-size sweep to confirm latency SLOs.
eval-bot: automated run started: 
```
run_eval --model perseus-30b --suites convo-robust,summarization-10k --quant-level 4 --out /tmp/perseus-4b-run
```
queued on bench-cluster-03. ETA ~2h.
Leo: good — can we add a focused check for polite refusal and tool-calling sanity? those were fragile in prior onboards.
Anya: suggest canary = 2% traffic, with auto-fallback to raven-55b if latency >150ms or regression delta >3% on core QA tests for 1h. :thumbsup:
Priya: approved. Sam please add cost/latency thresholds to the scoring sheet (column: "canary-fail-trigger"). Ben start infra job Wed 09:00 PT. Leo, tag the eval tests in test harness with labels: perseus:onboard and regression:hard.
Sam: acked. I'll open PR to quant-experiments with config and run scripts.
Ben: infra note — will need temporary capacity bump request (req-1234) for 48h. filing now.
deploy-bot: capacity request req-1234 approved for bench-cluster-03 (48h) by ops.
Priya: next sync Friday 10am PT for triage/decision. if eval-bot results look good and latency meets threshold, we run canary next week. Thanks all. :rocket:
